# CANDIDATE: LOW_ATR_RIBBON_ALIGN_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When volatility contracts (ATR below its 20-period average) and price is above VWAP with a bullish EMA ribbon alignment, a breakout above the prior day's high offers a short-term edge. This setup captures mean-reversion bursts after low-volatility compression, where the EMA ribbon confirms bullish momentum and the prior-day-high breakout signals institutional participation.

## Mechanism

Entry: ATR(14) < 0.5 * ATR(14) 20-period average AND close > VWAP AND EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 AND close > prior day's high (named level) on a closing basis; enter long at next bar open.  
Exit: Chart-stop at prior day low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 15% off HWM using a chandelier exit.  
Regime hints: Favored in low VIX (<15) and mid-morning (10:00-12:00 EST); avoid strong trend days (ADX > 25).
